components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The one creation or attention action on a working page.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:46px; padding:0 19px; border:1px solid #f05e4f; border-radius:0; background:#f05e4f; color:#12243d; font:800 13px 'Field Text',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#f47a6f; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #7de3d2; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Inspection and protected actions at rest.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height:46px; padding:0 19px; border:1px solid #173b5f; border-radius:0; background:#fff; color:#173b5f; font:800 13px 'Field Text',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:#f2f5f7; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #7de3d2; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Operational Field
components.description: A square labeled field for identity, dimensions, or reasons.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:7px; color:#455e73; font:700 10px 'Field Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-field input { height:45px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #aebfcb; border-radius:0; background:#fff; color:#12243d; font:400 13px 'Field Text',sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #7de3d2; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Active Status
components.css: .ds-active { display:inline-block; padding:5px 8px; border:1px solid #79b929; border-radius:1px; background:#f3fae9; color:#4b7f0d; font:700 10px 'Field Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; }

components.name: Register Panel
components.description: A flat ruled section inside an operational workbench.
components.html:
SITE REGISTER

Status and ownership values align in rows.
components.css: .ds-register { padding:22px; border:1px solid #b9c9d5; border-radius:0; background:#fff; color:#12243d; } .ds-register h2 { margin:0 0 14px; padding-bottom:14px; border-bottom:1px solid #d4dee5; font:900 25px 'Field Display',sans-serif; } .ds-register p { margin:0; color:#52697c; font:400 13px/1.5 'Field Text',sans-serif; }

components.name: Global Navigation
components.description: Dark Site or platform navigation with a ruled active route.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; min-height:72px; align-items:center; gap:30px; padding:0 24px; background:#091c31; color:#fff; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right:auto; font:900 24px 'Field Display',sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { align-self:stretch; border:0; border-bottom:3px solid transparent; background:transparent; color:#aebdca; font:800 13px 'Field Text',sans-serif; } .ds-nav button.active { border-bottom-color:#2f72e8; color:#fff; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #7de3d2; outline-offset:-4px; }

narrative.overview: LitterSpot looks like an operational register laid over a live site map. Dense records, exact boundaries, and explicit states matter more than decorative depth. Melissa's Supervisor and Cleaner interfaces remain the visual authority.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed display headings paired with plain body copy.
Monospaced labels only for status, measurements, IDs, and compact metadata.
Color communicates action or state, never decoration.

rules.name: The One Coral Action Rule
rules.body: Coral belongs to the single action that needs immediate attention. Healthy recovery controls remain secondary.

rules.name: The State Is Literal Rule
rules.body: Do not assign alert, health, or authority meaning to decorative color.

rules.name: The Measurement Font Rule
rules.body: Use mono for IDs, status, timestamps, coordinates, and measurements. Use Field Text for sentences and action labels.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Prefer a border or a tonal shift for resting hierarchy. Do not add shadows to ordinary cards, ledgers, or form sections.

dos: Do make Site, Camera, Alert, Work, and account state visible before offering an action.
Do use full-row targets for dense operational lists.
Do reserve the strongest color for the action that actually needs attention.
Do keep dialogs keyboard-contained and restore focus to their trigger.
donts: Don't build pages from disconnected same-size metric cards.
Don't use rounded soft-shadow containers in the operational product.
Don't color Zones or records in ways that imply untrue alert state.
Don't shrink operational labels below 9px or use low-contrast gray on paper.
